title: Security review applied: privilege split, trusted interrupts, leased delivery
summary: Acted on an independent security review: removed the API's sudo/root path in favour of a fixed root Docker snapshot timer, enabled NoNewPrivileges, made interrupt targeting depend only on read-only session evidence, added leased queue redelivery with nack, and closed upload, logging and information-leak gaps. Swift compile-review items were also fixed.
changes: Docker reads moved to beacon-docker.timer; API no longer runs sudo and now has NoNewPrivileges=yes and masked credential directories
Interrupt target from Cherry Studio sessions only; explicit session ids validated; pidfd signalling with re-verification
Queue deliveries leased and re-delivered after 120s (max 5 attempts) plus agent nack; per-client idempotency keys
Chunked-safe request ceiling, per-file and total screenshot quotas, upload throttles, action scope for activity writes
No query-string tokens, generic health errors, bounded log tailing, no absolute paths in user-facing errors
Swift review fixes: UIKit import, SWIFT_VERSION 5.0, polling starts on launch/sign-in

title: Hardening: protocol tests, restore drill and contract guardrails
summary: Closed the verification gaps left by live-only checks: every Minecraft control channel and the RCON/ping protocols are tested offline, Pi-hole payload parsing is replayed from recorded shapes, Docker and agent-runtime edge cases are covered, and a backup is restored into a fresh data directory and served by the API. Contract drift and static security checks are enforced by the test suite.
changes: 117 pytest tests (was 82): +10 Minecraft protocol/control, +6 Pi-hole parsing, +11 integration edges, +8 contract/security
Supervised pty stop, SIGINT fallback and the no-safe-channel refusal are asserted without touching the live server
Backup restore drill serves the restored milestone, token and screenshot bytes
OpenAPI snapshot equality, no-shell-execution checks and Docker helper allow-list tests added
SwiftUI call-site checker wired into the iOS validation script; optional-default compile hazards fixed

title: Final validation pass: live integrations, tests and retention drill
summary: Validated the whole system against the real services: 82 backend tests, 58 live checks, 13 Swift tests on Linux, all iOS sources parsed, the Xcode project structurally validated, and a live retention drill through the systemd unit.
changes: Pi-hole, Minecraft (NeoForge 21.1.252, 91 mods), Docker and host metrics verified live
Agent state, queue delivery and cooperative interrupt verified against the running runtime
Retention drill: aged screenshot deleted by beacon-retention.service, 410 confirmed, history preserved
iOS: SwiftUI app source complete; models/networking typechecked and tested; project validated
